usage: The word '曱甴' is used to refer to cockroaches, which are common household pests.
'曱甴' is a countable noun; you can say '一隻曱甴' to mean 'one cockroach.'
In conversation, '曱甴' can be used to express disgust or fear when talking about cockroaches.
You can also use '曱甴' metaphorically to describe someone sneaky or dirty, but this is informal.
When using '曱甴' in sentences, it usually appears as the subject or object of verbs related to seeing, killing, or talking about cockroaches.
